selection: Sort original120 by sha256(source_id UTF8), then source_id; first24; no label selection
eligibility: Candidate crop PNG SHA differs from query PNG SHA; no substitute samples; area/fullimage recorded
gate_question: Would inspecting an enlarged close-up of the frozen candidate region provide useful additional visible evidence for deciding whether that candidate region contains an industrial defect? query is the original448 image. candidate_bbox_in_query is [left,top,right,bottom], normalized0to1, x rightward and y downward. Only the original image is available at this stage; the proposed close-up is sampled from the recorded same-image bounds. Judge need for a closer view, not whether an anomaly is present. Use visible ambiguity, small details or uncertain texture. An unchanged full-image duplicate gives no additional detail. Do not invent unseen defects.

gate_criteria.true: An enlarged close-up of the recorded candidate would provide useful additional visual evidence.
gate_criteria.false: The recorded close-up is unnecessary or adds no useful visible evidence.

gate_inputs: Original448RGB plus fixed candidatebbox and category; no cropRGB,teacher map,label,oldprobability

policies.learned_gate: Highest crop_needed Noul among eligible; neutralhash tie
policies.historical_uncertainty: Original stage04 duplicate abs(p-.5) ascending among eligible; neutralhash tie
policies.geometry_small: Original normalized candidate area ascending among eligible; neutralhash tie

final_requests: New duplicate for all24 and new ROI for union of4 policy sets; no cached downstream outcomes
anomaly_question: Does the candidate region in the image identified by query contain at least one visible industrial anomaly (surface damage, contamination, missing material or component, or structural irregularity)? candidate_bbox_in_query is normalized [left, top, right, bottom] in query, with x increasing rightward and y downward. Judge that candidate region, not unrelated regions. second_view contains either a close-up of this same candidate region or an unchanged duplicate of query, as declared by second_view_kind. A candidate_crop is an enlarged view of the recorded original-image bounds with centered white padding; padding is not a defect. A duplicate_original adds no new visual region. Use only visible evidence. Ordinary differences in lighting, viewpoint, background or object identity alone are not defects.

anomaly_criteria.true: At least one visible industrial defect is present inside the candidate region.
anomaly_criteria.false: No visible industrial defect is present inside the candidate region.

sequence: All gate24 first; freeze gate/route/actual crop hashes; final newdups/ROI interleaved by sourcehash and armhash
evaluation: Exploratory previously viewed24; all strategies share same newly collected potential outcome table; gate24cost extra explicit
comparison: Each strategy vs newduplicate24; only selectedsubset has newly measured pairedROI potential outcomes
post_evaluation: After all newpredictions freeze: read only approved24 historical development labels and stage05 frozen candidateIoU, no new mask reads

bootstrap.category: Descriptive only; do not use categoryxlabel singleton bootstrap
bootstrap.limitation: Conditions on fixed24/routes/provider outcomes; excludes route selection/model/provider randomness

api_capability: Only already verified gateway image Noul; no Choice Score or Box request
limitation: Oldduplicate uncertainty has earlier collection time; selected24 may be unbalanced; small strata and provider timing not causal proof
